language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi, I am Skip Kangaroo. I like the months of the year.
I plant a bean every month. It all starts with the first month called January.
Next comes February. When the bean stalk from January starts to grow.
Also in March, April and May I plant a bean.
Bean stalks are growing higher from the beans planted in earlier months.
Then, in the months June, July and August I continue to plant a bean.
Wow, the previous stalks are growing high!
Finally, in September, October, November and December I also plant a bean every month.
Just look how my bean stalks have grown.
The bean stalk I planted first in January is the highest.
Beans planted later had less time to grow and are not so high. Compare the height of all the bean stalks.
A year has 12 months. Skip Kangeroo knows them all.
Compare how long each bean stalk is that Skip has planted.
